topics.title: A Prayer for the Bloodline
topics.subtitle: Repentance, Breaking, and Inheritance.
topics.lede: One prayer in eight movements. Iniquity is not sin left unaddressed. It is a door, opened long ago, that you did not open yourself. This is how you find it, close it, and put something better in its place.
topics.note: All Scripture from the World English Bible

blocks.v: Beloved Father, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, I come before You in the name of Yahshua, the light that breaks every dark timeline. I come as humbly as I know how. Please forgive me when I have wronged You, and others, with my words, my thoughts, and my deeds. Forgive me, Father, of my shortcomings, my failures, my unrighteousness. Hide Your face from my sins, blot out all my iniquities, and remember my sins no more. Do not cast me away from Your presence, and do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

You said You would visit iniquity, but iniquity is not sin left unaddressed. It is a door, opened long ago, that I did not open myself. So today I ask You: search me. Search my bloodline. Search my household, and show me what is hidden. Where there is a wound still open from generations back, from a moment I never witnessed, I ask You, Holy Spirit, to reveal it now. Show me the door. Show me the number of generations. Show me what was done, not to shame it, but to close it forever in the blood of Yahshua.

I repent, on behalf of my bloodline, for every act of rejection, every covenant with darkness, every rebellion disguised as survival. I break agreement with every pattern that was never mine to carry: every trigger, every cycle, every trauma that was rehearsed and wired into flesh and spirit before I ever had a choice. I break, reject, denounce, renounce, revoke, and sever all oaths, pacts, vows, curses, jinxes, vexes, spells, hexes, handshakes, covenants, obligations, assignments, and entrapments of the enemy, on every single level, from all cults and evil entities both physical and spiritual, and from all secret societies. Every bond and every attachment: off of me, off of my family, and out of our home.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

I declare that I am not bound to my father's timeline, or my mother's timeline, or any generation before me. I am Yours, Yahshua. Move me, move my children, move my household onto Your timeline, the pathway of life, washed clean by the blood of Yahshua. No root. No residue. No open door left behind.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

I will not stop asking. Like Elijah, I will pray until the heavens move. Like Daniel, I will not turn back, even if the answer is delayed by a fight I cannot see, because I know provision was already made the moment I cried out. I take authority over every power of darkness assigned to delay what You have already ordained. I do not fight flesh and blood. I storm the gates of hell, and I declare they will not prevail.

And Father, I do not just want the old thing cast out. I want righteousness planted in its place. Show me the new pattern You want me to walk in. Whatever You ask, a discipline, a fast, an obedience only You and I will know about, I say yes before I even hear the whole instruction, because I trust that You are building something in the secret place that will show itself in the open. Create in me a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me. Restore to me the joy of Your deliverance, and give me Your peace. Please give me a sound mind, with wisdom and discernment. Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing before You, O Yahshua, my rock and my redeemer.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

Please write Your instructions on my heart and on my mind. Hold my hand and guide me to walk in Your ways, and to be a witness to all whom I encounter with the fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self control. Help me to be an overcomer, Father. Help me to see myself as You see me. Protect my wife, my children, my family, my loved ones, and myself from all our enemies, both physical and spiritual. Put a hedge of protection around us, that no harm will overtake us. Please provide for our physical needs, and bless us with good health and protection while we walk this earth. Nourish our spirit with Your truth and Your shalom.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

Please, Father, do not let me or my family be deceived like so many seem to be with the strong delusion, for Your truth is beautiful, Your truth is life. Show my family and me the ancient path, where the good way is. Help us to walk in it, and give us rest for our souls.

Transform me as I behold You, Father. Not the patterns of this world, not the wounds of my past. Only You. Let my mind be wired by Your glory alone, so that what gets passed down through me is not iniquity, but inheritance: faith, freedom, and the image of Yahshua.
In the name of Yahshua, amen.

blocks.title: Passage Why It Is Here Part
blocks.v: Blot out my iniquities, create in me a clean heart 1, 6 Psalm 51:9 to 12 Visiting iniquity to the third and fourth generation 2 Exodus 34:7 Search me and know my heart 2 Psalm 139:23 to 24 Confessing their sins and the iniquities of their fathers 3 Nehemiah 9:2 The handwriting against us, nailed to the tree 3 Colossians 2:14 You will show me the path of life 4 Psalm 16:11 A new creation, the old things have passed away 4 2 Corinthians 5:17 Heard from the first day, delayed by an unseen fight 5 Daniel 10:12 to 13 Not against flesh and blood 5 Ephesians 6:12 The swept house that was left empty 6 Matthew 12:43 to 45 My instructions written on their hearts 7 Jeremiah 31:33 The fruit of the Spirit 7 Galatians 5:22 to 23 Ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is 8 Jeremiah 6:16 Transformed by the renewing of your mind 8 Romans 12:2
Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls.

topics.title: Praying Over Your Marriage
topics.subtitle: Thirty one prayers for covenant, cleansing, and unity
topics.lede: Thirty one prayers a husband and wife pray out loud together, in seven parts. You are not praying against your spouse. You are praying against everything that came to divide what YHWH joined.
topics.note: Scripture from the World English Bible, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai. A free printable prayer guide for husbands and wives.

blocks.v: These prayers were written to be prayed by a husband and wife together, out loud, in plain words. There is nothing magic about the order and nothing magic about the wording. They are here so you have somewhere to start when you do not know what to say, and so you stop praying vaguely about a covenant that deserves to be prayed over specifically.

items: Pray them out loud and pray them together. Something changes when a husband and wife hear each other say these things.
One section at a time is better than all thirty one at once. This is not a race and there is no prize for finishing fast.
Read the scripture after each prayer. The prayer is the ask. The verse is the ground it stands on.

blocks.v: If a prayer names something you have not dealt with yet, stop there. Repent, forgive, and then keep going.

items: When you say amen, start living like it is true. Prayer without a change in how you treat each other is just noise.

blocks.v: A word before the warfare sections. Nothing in here gives you permission to treat your husband or wife like the enemy. If you catch yourself praying one of these at your spouse instead of for your marriage, stop and go back to Prayer 2.
Nothing else in this book works until this part is settled. You cannot war for a marriage you are not willing to be corrected in.
Pride is the root of unforgiveness. Humility is the root of forgiveness. Start here, or none of the rest of these prayers will land.
1. Prayer of Approach

Father YHWH, we come to You together. Not as two people trying to fix each other, but as two people who need You. You made this covenant and You know every part of it that is working and every part of it that is broken. We are not hiding anything from You today. Open our ears and let us hear what You actually say, not what we want to hear. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Unless YHWH builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless YHWH watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
Psalm 127:1
2. Prayer for Humility

Father YHWH, show us where pride is hiding in us, and do not let us call it something else. It disguises itself as being right, as being tired, as having a point. We would rather be corrected than be right. Take the part of us that keeps score and put it to death. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, Elohim resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble. Be subject therefore to Elohim. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
James 4:6-7
3. Prayer for Correction

Father YHWH, we are asking for correction and we mean it. Show each of us our own part before You show us our spouse's part. Let Your Spirit lead us into every change this marriage needs, and give us the courage to make it instead of waiting for the other person to move first. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

Don't grieve the Holy Spirit of Elohim, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption. Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice. And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as Elohim also in Messiah forgave you.
Ephesians 4:30-32
4. Prayer for Forgiveness Between Us

Father YHWH, we forgive each other today. Not when the feeling shows up. Now. Every offense we have carried, every record we have kept, every wound we have held onto because it gave us leverage, we let it go. Forgive us the same way we have forgiven each other, and let forgiveness be the ground everything else in this house is built on. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
Matthew 6:14-15
Marriage was not invented by a culture or a government, so no culture or government gets to redefine it for you. It was given in a garden before there was a nation, a temple, or a priesthood.
5. Thanksgiving for Marriage

Father YHWH, thank You for marriage. Thank You that You looked at a man standing alone and said that was the one thing in all of creation that was not good. Thank You that You did not leave him that way. We receive this covenant as a gift and not as a sentence. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
YHWH Elohim said, It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.
Genesis 2:18
6. Prayer for YHWH's Design

Father YHWH, keep us inside Your design. Not the world's version of marriage, not the version we watched growing up, not the version we picked up somewhere along the way. Teach us Your order for a husband and a wife, and give us the willingness to walk in it even where it costs us something. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

But from the beginning of the creation, Elohim made them male and female. For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife, and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh. What therefore Elohim has joined together, let no man separate.
Mark 10:6-9
7. Prayer Against Divorce and Separation

Father YHWH, we take the word divorce out of our mouths and out of our thinking. Cancel every plan of separation, every threat thrown in anger, and every quiet expectation that this will not last. What You joined, no man separates, and we refuse to be the ones who try. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Yet you say, Why? Because YHWH has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.
Malachi 2:14
8. Prayer for One Flesh

Father YHWH, make us one and not two people sharing an address. Join our hearts, our thinking, our money, our bodies, and our purpose. Where we have quietly pulled apart, close the gap before it becomes a canyon. Let nothing stand in the middle of what You made one. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
Genesis 2:24
You cannot build something new on top of a wound you keep covering. This section is about letting YHWH get underneath it.
Cleansing is not a feeling. It is a settled fact, paid for at the cross. Pray it as something already finished, not something you are hoping He will get around to.
9. Prayer for Cleansing by the Blood

Father YHWH, cover this marriage in the blood of Yahshua. Every sin we have confessed is already forgiven, and every accusation against us was answered at the cross. Let nothing rise up against this home that Your Son has not already paid for. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Yahshua Messiah his Son cleanses us from all sin. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1 John 1:7, 9
10. Prayer Over Our Bloodlines

Father YHWH, we bring our families before You, both sides, as far back as it goes. Where there were patterns of divorce, betrayal, addiction, and control, we refuse to carry them one more generation. We are not bound to what our fathers did. Cut the line here and let a new pattern start with us. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Messiah redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us.
The son will not bear the iniquity of the father, neither will the father bear the iniquity of the son.
Ezekiel 18:20
11. Prayer to Uproot What Was Planted

Father YHWH, pull up every root of bitterness, suspicion, and resentment that has been growing in this marriage. Do not trim it back. Pull it out. Throw it into the depths of the sea, and do not let us go wading out there looking for it again. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot, and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
Micah 7:19
12. Prayer for Deep Healing

Father YHWH, heal what is under the surface. Heal the words that landed years ago and never came back out. Heal the memories that still make us flinch. Heal the trust that was broken, and rebuild it stronger than it was before it broke. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Heal me, YHWH, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved, for you are my praise.
Jeremiah 17:14
13. Prayer for Restored Years

Father YHWH, give us back the years we lost. The seasons we spent arguing, the time we spent apart while living in the same house, everything the enemy ate out of this marriage while we were not paying attention. Give them back with interest, and let the second half be better than the first. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army which I sent among you.
Joel 2:25
There is real opposition to a covenant marriage, and pretending otherwise has never helped anyone. But the fight is not where most couples aim it.
You are not praying against your spouse. Read that again before you start this section, and do not pray a single one of these with your husband or wife in mind as the target.
14. Prayer Against Spiritual Attack

Father YHWH, open our eyes to see what is actually coming against us. Tear down every stronghold built in our thinking, every argument that has become a fortress, and every lie we have agreed with. We stand in the authority of Yahshua and not in our own strength. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

For though we walk in the flesh, we don't wage war according to the flesh; for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before Elohim to the throwing down of strongholds, throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of Elohim, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Messiah.
2 Corinthians 10:3-5
15. Prayer Against Principalities and Rulers

Father YHWH, we stand against every principality, power, and ruler of darkness assigned to this marriage and to our children. We are not wrestling with flesh and blood, so we will stop fighting with flesh and blood weapons. Send them out of this home in the name of Yahshua Messiah.

For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
Ephesians 6:12
16. Prayer Against Every Counterfeit Covenant

Father YHWH, we break every tie and every agreement that competes with this covenant. Every attachment formed before we met, every attachment formed since, and every unclean thing that thinks it still has a claim on either of us. It has no claim. We belong to You, and we belong to each other. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
But he who is joined to Adonai is one spirit.
1 Corinthians 6:17
17. Prayer Against Manipulation and Control

Father YHWH, take manipulation and control out of this marriage. The silent treatment, the flattery that is really a setup, the threats we make to get our way. We refuse the spirit that runs on strife. Give us plain speech, straight answers, and a home where love leads instead of fear. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
James 3:16
18. Prayer Against Witchcraft and Spoken Curses

Father YHWH, every incantation, hex, spell, and curse spoken over this marriage falls to the ground unanswered. Every word spoken against us in secret, whether by a stranger or by someone who sat at our table, has no power here. We answer all of it with Your word. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel.
Numbers 23:23
19. Prayer Against What Devours the Seed

Father YHWH, guard what You have planted in us. Every good word, every promise, every fresh start gets stolen before it can take root unless You watch over it. Do not let distraction, exhaustion, or the enemy take one more seed off the ground. Let this one grow up and bear fruit. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, a farmer went out to sow. As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
Matthew 13:3-4
Most marriages are not lost in one dramatic moment. They are lost through a door somebody left propped open.
20. Prayer Against Outside Interference

Father YHWH, block every outside hand reaching into this marriage. Family members who take sides, friends who carry our business back and forth, coworkers who get more of us in a week than we give each other. Nothing gets access to this house unless it is building this house. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, contention ceases.
Proverbs 26:20
21. Prayer Against Evil Counsel

Father YHWH, shut the mouth of every voice telling us to quit. We will not take advice about marriage from people who have never built one. Surround us with counselors who fear You and who will tell us the truth even when we do not want to hear it. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Proverbs 11:14
22. Prayer for Discernment

Father YHWH, sharpen our discernment. Let us know the difference between a hard season and an actual attack, between conviction and condemnation, between a friend and a flatterer. Train our senses so we stop getting caught by the same thing twice. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
Hebrews 5:14
23. Prayer Over What Enters Our Home

Father YHWH, we take responsibility for what comes through our doors and through our screens. What we watch, what we scroll, what we listen to, what we let sit in our minds at night. If it works against this marriage, we are finished with it. As for us and our house, we serve YHWH. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
I will walk within my house with a perfect heart. I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
Psalm 101:2-3
Warfare prayers do not replace kindness. You can bind every principality over your city and still lose your marriage by how you speak at the kitchen table.
Most of what married people fight about is not what they are actually fighting about. Ask before you assume.
24. Prayer Against Misunderstanding

Father YHWH, clear the fog between us. So much of what we argue over is not even the thing we think it is. Give us the patience to hear the whole sentence before we answer, and the humility to ask what was meant instead of assuming the worst. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
So then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger.
James 1:19
25. Prayer for Love and Patience

Father YHWH, fill us with the love Yahshua commanded, which is not a feeling we wait around for but a decision we make. Patient when it is inconvenient. Kind when it is not deserved. Keeping no record of wrongs. Let people know whose we are by how we treat each other at home. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
26. Prayer Against Fear and Rejection

Father YHWH, take fear out of this marriage. Fear of being left, fear of not being enough, fear of being fully known. You did not give us a spirit of fear, and perfect love drives it out. Make us safe with each other. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
1 John 4:18
27. Prayer Over Our Words

Father YHWH, guard our mouths. Death and life are in the tongue, and we have used ours both ways. Stop the words that tear down before they ever leave us, and give us words that build. Do not let us fall asleep angry or leave the enemy an opening. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
Be angry, and don't sin. Don't let the sun go down on your wrath, and don't give place to the devil.
Ephesians 4:26-27
Prayer sets the direction. Obedience covers the distance. These last four are for the road ahead.
28. Prayer for Wisdom

Father YHWH, give us wisdom for the decisions right in front of us. Not opinions, not whatever everyone else is doing, but Your wisdom. You give it freely to anyone who asks, so we are asking. Build this house by wisdom and hold it up by understanding. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established; by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of Elohim, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
James 1:5
29. Prayer for Purpose

Father YHWH, remind us why You put us together. We are not here just to survive each other. There is work in front of us, children to raise, people to serve, and a testimony to carry. Take off every weight slowing us down and make this marriage useful to Your kingdom. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. And if a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Ecclesiastes 4:9, 12
30. Prayer for Forward Movement

Father YHWH, we are not going back. Not to the old arguments, not to the old habits, not to the version of this marriage we already repented of. You said You are doing a new thing. Help us recognize it and walk straight into it. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

Don't remember the former things, and don't consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don't you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Isaiah 43:18-19
31. Prayer of Agreement

Father YHWH, we agree together on everything we have prayed. We agree that this covenant stands. We agree that forgiveness is the ground we walk on. We agree that You finish what You start. Whatever two of us agree on in the name of Yahshua, You hear. So let it be done. In the name of Yahshua Messiah.

Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven. For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.
Matthew 18:19-20
Every prayer in this guide is anchored to Scripture. If you disagree with something written here, go to the text and let the text settle it.
Write down what you are believing for, what you forgave, and the date you prayed it. Come back later and see what YHWH did.
If you pray these and nothing changes overnight, pray them again tomorrow. Covenant is not a mood. It is a decision you keep making until it becomes who you are.

topics.title: The Spirit of Lust
topics.subtitle: Recognizing It, Renouncing It, Walking Free
topics.lede: I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
topics.note: Scripture quoted from the World English Bible, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai.

blocks.title: The Heart Of It
blocks.v: Lust is not only what the eyes see. It is a spirit that hijacks a desire YHWH made good and turns it against his design. Scripture does not leave us guessing about its fruit, and it does not leave us without a door out. This handout is a mirror, not a checklist for your neighbor. Bring it into the light and let YHWH search your own heart first.

rows.v: WHERE TO READ IT

blocks.v: Yahshua went straight past behavior and named the place where this starts.
I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

He is not lowering the standard or raising it arbitrarily. He is telling you where the battle actually is. A man can keep his hands clean his whole life and still be handing his heart over daily. That is why willpower alone never sets anyone free. Willpower manages the hands. Yahshua goes after the heart, because the heart is what he is after in all of it.
James lays out the sequence plainly, and every one of us can trace our own story in it.
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed. Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

Notice there is a gap between drawn away and conceived. That gap is where freedom lives. Once desire is entertained, fed, replayed, and protected, it conceives, and what is conceived always gets born. Most people try to fight at the delivery room. Scripture tells you to deal with it at the door.
Paul names it in the list of things that war against the Spirit.
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness.

blocks.title: Say It Plainly
blocks.v: Desire itself is not the enemy. YHWH made it, and inside covenant he calls it good and even commands delight in it (Proverbs 5:18-19; Song of Solomon 4:9-10; 1 Corinthians 7:3-5). Lust is that same good desire pulled out of covenant and pointed at whatever is in front of it. The enemy has never created a single appetite. He only counterfeits and redirects what YHWH already made.

Scripture describes a consistent pattern where this spirit is at work in a life. These five traits are not a personality test. They are fingerprints, and they are here so you can recognize them in your own house before they take root.
1. Insatiability. Never satisfied, always pursuing more. What satisfied last year does not satisfy now, so the appetite escalates. That escalation is the tell.
Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man's eyes are never satisfied.

2. Deception and self justification. It always builds a case for itself. It renames things. It calls it curiosity, art, research, relaxation, or just how men are. A person under it can sin and genuinely feel they have done nothing wrong.
So is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and says, I have done nothing wrong.

3. Objectification. It turns image bearers into things to be used. Every person you look at was made in the image of YHWH (Genesis 1:27). The moment a person becomes a means to your appetite, something in you has agreed with a lie about who they are and who you are.
That each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor, not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who do not know Elohim.

4. Secrecy and darkness. This spirit builds rooms nobody is allowed into: deleted history, a second account, a locked phone, a story that has to be managed. Anything that has to stay hidden to survive is already telling you what it is.

Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them. For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of. But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light.

5. Restlessness of spirit. An inner drivenness that is not rooted in love but in appetite. Love can wait, can be told no, and can be at peace. Appetite cannot sit still. If you cannot be alone, bored, or unstimulated without reaching for something, that restlessness is information.
But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can't rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.
Proverbs 27:20; Ecclesiastes 1:8; Habakkuk 2:5
Proverbs 30:20; Jeremiah 17:9; Proverbs 16:2

rows.v: SCRIPTURE

blocks.v: None of us are exempt from being tested here. The list above is not there so you can diagnose your spouse, your brother, or the man teaching on Saturday night. The second a checklist becomes a microscope pointed at someone else, pride has already gotten hold of it, and pride is the one thing that guarantees you stay stuck.
Search me, Elohim, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

Pray that before you read anything else in this handout again. Ask him to search you, then sit still long enough to let him answer. He is not looking for a way to condemn you. He is looking for a door you have left open, and he is pointing at it because he wants it shut.
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn't fall.

blocks.title: Two Things To Hold Together
blocks.v: Everyone is tested here, and no one is beyond help here. Paul says in the very next verse that no temptation has taken you except what is common to man, and that YHWH is faithful and will make the way of escape (1 Corinthians 10:13). Common to man means you are not a special case. Way of escape means there is always a door, and it is always his to open.
If you saw yourself in section two, pay close attention to what you do with that feeling, because two very different voices show up at this exact moment and they sound similar at first.

rows.v: CONDEMNATION, THE ACCUSER

blocks.v: Names you as the thing For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

Shame says hide it. The Ruach says bring it into the light, because light is where things die. If you feel drawn toward YHWH in the middle of this, that is not you getting away with something. That is him coming after you, and the fact that you still feel it is mercy.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Messiah Yahshua, who don't walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

sections.heading: The Way Out, Step by Step

blocks.v: This is the order that actually breaks things, and the order matters. Most people jump straight to trying harder, which is step nowhere. Walk it through in sequence.
Conviction. Agree with what he just showed you. No softening the language, no comparing yourself to someone worse. Call the thing what he calls it.
Confession. Say it out loud to YHWH, and where it is right to do so, to a trusted brother or sister who will pray and not gossip. Secrecy is the oxygen. Confession cuts the supply.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed.

Renounce the stronghold. Confession admits it. Renouncing breaks agreement with it. Out loud, in the name of Yahshua, you tell it plainly that you are no longer in agreement with it, that it has no claim, and that every door you opened is now closed. This is not a formula or a ritual. It is you verbally taking back ground you handed over.
Be subject therefore to Elohim. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Draw near to Elohim, and he will draw near to you.

Forgive. This is the step most people skip, and it is the one that holds the door open. Forgive whoever wounded you, including whoever exposed you to this in the first place, and forgive yourself the way he already has. Pride is the root of unforgiveness, and unforgiveness is legal ground. Humility is the root of forgiveness, and forgiveness is the root of deliverance.
For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

Restore. If this spirit caused you to wound someone, go make it right. Not a vague apology, and not a confession that dumps details on someone in order to relieve your own conscience. Name what you did, own it with no excuse attached, and ask forgiveness. Where restitution is owed, pay it.

If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you, leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

Walk free in identity. Deliverance is not shame. It is the doorway back to who you actually are. Paul lists the exact sins this handout deals with, and then says the most important four words in the whole subject.
Such were some of you, but you were washed. But you were sanctified. But you were justified in the name of Adonai Yahshua, and in the Spirit of our Elohim.

blocks.title: Such Were Some Of You
blocks.v: Were. Past tense. He does not say you are the sum of what you did, and he does not put you on probation. Washed, sanctified, justified. If YHWH has moved it to past tense, you do not get to keep dragging it back into the present and calling that humility. That is agreement with the accuser wearing humble clothes.

Yahshua warned about a house swept clean and left empty (Matthew 12:43-45). Renouncing empties the house. What you fill it with decides whether you stay free. Freedom is kept the same way it was received, by walking with him daily, not by white knuckling it alone.

items: Make a covenant with your eyes. Job did, and he said it out loud as a settled decision, not a hope (Job 31:1; Psalm 101:3).

Cut off the access point. Yahshua used deliberately extreme language about removing what causes you to stumble (Matthew 5:29-30). Filters, no phone in the bedroom, an app deleted, a route changed, a friendship ended. Whatever it actually takes.
Flee instead of fighting. Scripture never tells you to stand your ground here. It tells you to run (1 Corinthians 6:18; 2 Timothy 2:22). Joseph left the coat and got out of the house (Genesis 39:12).
Do not feed it. Make no provision for the flesh (Romans 13:14). Most falls are decided hours earlier, in the small allowance nobody saw.
Fill the space with his word and worship. Guard your heart, because everything flows out of it (Proverbs 4:23), and set your mind on what is true, honorable, pure, and lovely (Philippians 4:8).
Walk in the light with someone. One person who can ask you the hard question and will pray instead of talk (James 5:16; Ecclesiastes 4:9-10).

If you are married, pour it back into your covenant. Delight in the spouse of your youth on purpose (Proverbs 5:18-19; 1 Corinthians 7:3-5). But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh.

blocks.v: And if you stumble, the answer is not to start the hiding cycle over. Come back into the light the same day. A righteous man falls seven times and rises again (Proverbs 24:16). The direction of your walk matters more than the perfection of it.

Words matter. You did not get here silently, and you do not get free silently. Pray this out loud, slowly, and fill in the blanks with the specific things he brings to mind. A fuller version of this prayer is available as a separate printable page.

blocks.title: Prayer Of Renouncing
blocks.v: Father YHWH, I come to you in the name of Yahshua. I am not hiding anything from you today. I confess that I have given my eyes, my thoughts, and my desire to what you did not give me, specifically this: ______________________. I agree with you about it. I call it what you call it, and I am done defending it.

items: I renounce the spirit of lust and every agreement I have made with it, knowingly or in ignorance. I renounce every image, every fantasy, and every soul tie formed outside your covenant, and I break agreement with all of it in the name of Yahshua. It has no claim on me, no ground in me, and no say over me. Every door I opened, I close now by the blood of Yahshua.

I forgive those who wounded me and those who first put this in front of me, and I release them fully. I receive your forgiveness, and I forgive myself, because you have already washed me. Where I have wounded someone, give me the humility to go make it right.

Wash me with water by the word. Fill the place this used to occupy with your Ruach so it does not sit empty. Restore my sight, restore my desire to your design, and restore me to who you say I am. I belong to you. I am washed, I am sanctified, I am justified in the name of Yahshua. Amen.

blocks.v: The heart of the matter
Matthew 5:27-30; James 1:14-15; Proverbs 4:23; Mark 7:20-23; Jeremiah 17:9-10
Named among the works of the flesh
Galatians 5:19-24; Colossians 3:5-7; Ephesians 5:3-7; 1 Peter 4:1-3
Never satisfied
Proverbs 27:20; Ecclesiastes 1:8; Habakkuk 2:5; Proverbs 30:15-16
Deception and self justification
Proverbs 30:20; Proverbs 16:2; Proverbs 21:2; Jeremiah 17:9; 1 John 1:8
People as image bearers
Genesis 1:27; 1 Thessalonians 4:3-8; 2 Samuel 11:2-4; Job 31:1
Secrecy and the light
Ephesians 5:8-14; John 3:19-21; Proverbs 28:13; Luke 8:17; Numbers 32:23
Search me and know me
Psalm 139:23-24; Psalm 19:12-14; Psalm 51:1-12; Lamentations 3:40
Conviction, not condemnation
Romans 8:1-2; 2 Corinthians 7:9-11; John 16:8; Revelation 12:10-11
Confession and cleansing
1 John 1:7-9; James 5:16; Proverbs 28:13; Psalm 32:3-5
Renouncing and resisting
James 4:6-10; 2 Corinthians 10:3-5; Ephesians 4:27; Ephesians 6:10-18; 1 Peter 5:6-9
Forgiveness as the door
Matthew 6:14-15; Matthew 18:21-35; Ephesians 4:31-32; Colossians 3:13; Mark 11:25
Making it right
Matthew 5:23-24; Luke 19:8; Numbers 5:6-7; Romans 12:18
Fleeing and guarding
1 Corinthians 6:18-20; 2 Timothy 2:22; Genesis 39:7-12; Romans 13:14; Philippians 4:8; Matthew 5:29-30
Filling the house
Matthew 12:43-45; Galatians 5:16-25; Romans 12:1-2; Colossians 3:1-5

Desire inside covenant

Write down what he showed you while it is still fresh, the specific thing you renounced, who you need to go make it right with, and the date you prayed it. Freedom is worth a record.

topics.title: Deliverance Prayer
topics.subtitle: Breaking With the Spirit of Lust
topics.note: Scripture quoted from the World English Bible, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai.

blocks.title: Before You Pray
blocks.v: Pray this out loud. You did not come into this silently and you do not come out of it silently. Words are how agreement is made and words are how agreement is broken. This is not a formula, and the power is not in the page. It is in Yahshua, and in a heart that is done hiding. Go slowly. Where there is a blank, say the specific thing out loud. Where he brings something to mind that is not written here, stop and deal with that too. If you can, pray it with one trusted brother or sister who will pray and not gossip.
Nothing hidden, nothing renamed, nothing softened.

Father YHWH, I come to you in the name of Yahshua. I am not hiding from you today and I am not managing the truth in front of you. You already see all of it, and you have loved me the whole time you have been looking at it.

I confess that I have taken a desire you made good and given it to what you did not give me. Specifically, I confess this before you: __________________________________________________ . I am not going to call it anything other than what you call it. I am not going to explain it, excuse it, or compare it to somebody else's sin to make it look smaller.
Search me, Elohim, and know my heart. Show me anything else I have been protecting, and I will bring that into the light too.
Confession admits it. Renouncing breaks agreement with it.

In the name of Yahshua, I renounce the spirit of lust and every agreement I have made with it, whether I made it knowingly or in ignorance. I renounce it as a friend, as a comfort, as a way to cope, and as a place I went when I was lonely, bored, angry, or unseen.
I renounce every lie I believed underneath it: that I cannot be free, that this is just who I am, that I need it, that nobody would love me if they knew. I break agreement with all of it now.

I renounce every image, every fantasy, and every scene I have replayed in my mind. I renounce every soul tie formed outside your covenant, with anyone, in person or on a screen, and I ask you to sever what was never meant to be joined and to return to me what was mine.
You have no claim on me, no ground in me, and no say over me. I belong to Yahshua, who bought me with his own blood.
Name the access points out loud. Ground is taken back door by door.
Father, I take responsibility for the doors I opened. What I chose to watch, what I chose to click, what I chose to keep, what I chose to excuse, and the hours I chose to spend alone with it.

I take responsibility for the doors I left standing open through anger I would not release, wounds I nursed, and unforgiveness I called wisdom. I close every one of them now in the name of Yahshua and by his blood.
I ask you to show me anything I still need to cut off, delete, hand over, or walk away from. Whatever it is, I will do it. I am not negotiating with this anymore.

I also renounce anything that came down my family line, any pattern that was handed to me before I could choose, and any covenant my ancestors made that I never agreed to. It stops with me, in the name of Yahshua.
This is the step most people skip, and it is the one holding the door.

Father, I forgive the people who wounded me, the ones who took something from me, and the ones who first put this in front of me before I even knew what it was. I name them now: __________________________________________________ .
I release them fully. I am not holding this over them and I am not waiting for an apology to let it go. I hand the whole account to you and I will not pick it back up.

I receive your forgiveness, and I forgive myself, because you have already washed me. I will not keep calling dirty what you have called clean, and I will not keep dragging into today what you have moved into the past.
Pride is what kept me holding this, and pride is what kept me hiding. I humble myself before you now and I ask you for grace.
Deliverance that costs you nothing usually changes nothing.

Father, where this has wounded someone else, I am not going to hide behind your forgiveness and leave them carrying it. Give me the humility to go to them, to name what I did without excuse, and to ask their forgiveness without demanding it.

Give me wisdom in how I say it, so that I am seeking their healing and not just relief for my own conscience. Where restitution is owed, show me and I will pay it. Where trust was broken, give me the patience to rebuild it slowly instead of demanding it back.
Guard my wife, my husband, my children, and my house from what I let in. Undo the damage I cannot undo.
The house does not stay empty. Ask him to fill it.

Yahshua, wash me. Wash my eyes, my mind, my memory, my hands, and my heart with water by the word. Cover me with your blood. Blot out what has been written on my mind and give me back a clean imagination.

Fill every place this used to occupy with your Ruach, so it does not sit swept and empty. Where the appetite was, put hunger for you. Where the restlessness was, put your peace. Where the secrecy was, put the light.
Renew my mind. Teach me to set my eyes on what is true, honorable, pure, and lovely, and to walk in the Spirit so that I do not fulfill the desires of the flesh.
Give me a covenant with my eyes, and the strength to keep it today, and then tomorrow, and then the day after that.
Say these out loud. This is not positive thinking, it is agreement with him.
I am washed. I am sanctified. I am justified in the name of Adonai Yahshua and in the Spirit of our Elohim.
There is no condemnation for me, because I am in Messiah Yahshua. I am a new creation. The old is gone.
Whom the Son sets free is free indeed. I am not what I did. I am his, and I am walking in the light with him from here.
If I stumble, I will come back into the light the same day instead of hiding. I will not let the accuser use one fall to talk me out of what you settled at the cross.
Thank you, Father. Thank you for conviction that draws instead of condemns. Thank you for not being ashamed of me. In the name of Yahshua, amen.
The enemy will try to talk you out of this later. Write it down now so you have something to point at when he does.

blocks.title: One More Thing
blocks.v: Do not carry this alone. Tell one person you trust today, and ask them to pray with you and to check on you. Secrecy is what kept this alive, and walking in the light with someone is how it stays dead.

topics.title: Breaking the Generational Curse Line
topics.subtitle: Six steps to freedom from an attack that started before you were born
topics.lede: Some people fight the same battle their entire life and never understand where it came from. The same torment. The same rage. The same fear that shows up with no cause. The same sin pattern they swore they would never repeat, showing up in them anyway. They repent, they pray, they fast, and it still will not lift. Very often the reason is simple: they are not the one who opened the door. Somebody upstream in the bloodline opened it, and what came through that door did not stop at one generation. This teaching lays out six steps, in order, for shutting that door and driving out what came through it. The order is not a suggestion. Each step removes a claim the enemy has been standing on. If you skip to the end and start commanding spirits to leave while their ground is still intact, they will not go, and you will walk away thinking deliverance does not work.

sections.heading: Why a bloodline can carry an attack

blocks.v: ...visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children's children, on the third and on the fourth generation.

sections.kicker: EXODUS 34:7 (WEB, DIVINE NAME RENDERED YHWH, ELOHIM, AND ADONAI)

blocks.v: That verse troubles a lot of people, because Scripture is also plain that a child is not guilty of a parent's sin:
The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son.

Both are true, and they are not in conflict. Guilt is not inherited. Consequence is. YHWH is not punishing you for what your father did. What happened is that your father's sin opened a legal door in the family line, and the spirits that walked through that door kept working the bloodline after him. You did not sign the agreement. You were just born inside the house where it was signed. That is why you can be fully forgiven and still be under attack, and it is why repentance alone sometimes does not end it. The sin is forgiven. The door is still standing open.
The good news is that a door can be shut and a claim can be revoked, and Yahshua has already purchased every bit of the authority you need to do it.

blocks.title: Read This First
blocks.v: Forgiveness is not the same thing as access. Forgiving a parent does not mean moving back in, restoring contact, handing them your children, or staying quiet about what happened. You can fully release someone before YHWH and still keep a locked door between you and them. Those are two different decisions. Safety comes before ministry. If someone is being harmed right now, especially a child, the first step is not a prayer. The first step is getting them out of harm's way and to the people whose job it is to protect them. Deliverance ministry does not replace protection, and it never covers for an abuser. Do not send a wounded person in alone. Sit with them. Let mature believers stand with them. Give them time, and do not rush someone into words they are not ready to mean. This is a prayer of the will, not of the feelings. Nobody feels forgiving toward a person who wrecked their childhood. YHWH is not asking for the feeling. He is asking for the decision. He will handle the healing of the feelings afterward, and He will take His time doing it well.

1. Come into full surrender with YHWH. 2. Confess the sins of the sinning parent before the Father. 3. Be willing to fully forgive the sinning parent. 4. Break every ungodly soul tie with that parent. 5. Break the curse line the spirits have been feeding on. 6. Verbally command the spirits to leave, in the name of Yahshua.
Be subject therefore to Elohim. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

Look at the order in that one verse, because the whole teaching sits on it. Submit first. Resist second. Then he flees. Most people try to start at the middle of the verse. They want the fleeing without the submitting, and it does not work that way.

Full surrender means every part of you goes on the table. Body, soul, spirit, mind, will, emotions, money, marriage, calendar, future. It means YHWH takes the wheel and you stop negotiating about where He is allowed to drive. If there is a room in the house you are still keeping the key to, the enemy knows exactly which room it is, and that is the room he will keep working out of.

This is also where you deal with your own sin, not just your parent's. Anything you are still holding onto, still justifying, still hiding, bring it out and put it under the blood of Yahshua before you go any further.

sections.heading: Step 2 · Confess the Sins of the Bloodline

blocks.v: If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me... then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham.

This is the step people push back on hardest. Why would YHWH ask me to confess something I did not do? You are not taking the blame for it and you are not repenting on their behalf. You are naming the door. You are standing before the Father and saying out loud, in agreement with Him, exactly what was done and that it was sin. Darkness runs on secrecy. Nothing loses its grip faster than being said out loud in the light.

There is a second reason. He wants you to know what you are dealing with. When you trace it back and see the actual thing that opened the door, the attack stops feeling random. It has a name, a source, and a date. Something you can see is something you can cut off.

items: Go as far back as you can honestly trace. Parents first. Then grandparents. Then great grandparents if you know anything about them.

Name the heavy ones specifically: bloodshed, sexual sin, abuse, occult involvement, witchcraft, divination, familiar spirits, idolatry, oaths, vows, dedications, secret societies, and covenants made with anything other than YHWH.
Then cover the rest in one sweep. Most families have sin nobody talks about and nobody living remembers. Confess the unknown along with the known so nothing is left standing behind a locked door.

sections.heading: Step 3 · Be Willing to Fully Forgive

blocks.v: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

Forgiveness is the root of deliverance. It is not one item on the list, it is the hinge the whole thing swings on, and it is the step the enemy will fight you hardest over. When a child is beaten, screamed at, used, or violated, and that is never dealt with, the hate and the rage and the shame settle down into the deep places and harden there. A stronghold forms. Spirits do not attach to empty air. They attach to that, and they feed on it for decades.

Underneath unforgiveness there is almost always pride. Pride is sneaky and it will dress itself up as something noble: I am protecting myself, I am standing up for what is right, I am not going to let them off the hook. What it really is, is a claim to hold a debt that belongs to YHWH. Humility is what lets it go. That is why humility is the root of forgiveness and pride is the root of unforgiveness.
Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides.

Releasing your parent is not saying it was fine. It is not saying it was small. It is not clearing them of anything. It is handing the case file to the only Judge who can actually try it, and taking your own hands off it. Their judgment rests with Him. Yours does too.

If your feelings are nowhere near this yet, say it anyway and tell the Father the truth about where you are. He is not asking you to fake an emotion. He is asking for your cooperation. He will do the inner healing after, and He is very good at it.

sections.heading: Step 4 · Break Every Ungodly Soul Tie

blocks.v: A soul tie is a real bond between two people. Scripture shows us the principle plainly: joining yourself to someone ties you to them, and joining yourself to the Master makes you one spirit with Him (1 Corinthians 6:16 and 17). Some ties are good and YHWH built them on purpose. Husband and wife. Parent and child. Covenant friendship, the way David and Jonathan were knit together.

The bond between a parent and a child is one YHWH designed, and it is supposed to be one of the safest things a person ever has. Abuse corrupts it. When a parent uses that bond as a leash instead of a shelter, the tie is still there, but now it runs the wrong direction, and everything operating on that parent has a cord running straight into the child.

Breaking an ungodly soul tie does not break the command to honor your father and mother, and it does not mean you stop loving them or praying for them. It cuts the corrupted cord the enemy has been feeding through. Being related by blood does not obligate you to stay spiritually fused to someone who will not turn from evil.

items: Ties formed through abuse, whether physical, verbal, or sexual.
Ties formed through fear, control, manipulation, and intimidation.
Ties formed through unhealthy dependence, on either side.
Ties formed through any words spoken over you: curses, labels, predictions, and dedications.

blocks.v: ...whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

Now the ground is cleared. You have surrendered, you have confessed the bloodline, you have forgiven, and you have cut the cords. The curse line has nothing left propping it up, and it is time to cut it.

Do it in two motions. First ask the Father to break it, because you have done what He asked of you in the first four steps. Then take the authority He has already given you in Yahshua and speak to it directly. Do not ask the curse line nicely. Address it and command it, every strand, every root, every link, from both sides of the family, as far back as it runs. Broken, severed, finished, in the name of Yahshua.

sections.heading: Step 6 · Command the Spirits to Leave

blocks.v: With the curse line cut, there is nothing left for them to hold onto, and now you engage them directly. Say it out loud. The sword of the Spirit is the word of YHWH (Ephesians 6:17), and a sword in the sheath does not cut anything. Yahshua cast out spirits by speaking to them, and He gave that same authority to those who follow Him.

Speak plainly and speak with authority, not with volume. You are not persuading them and you are not negotiating with them. You are serving an eviction notice that has already been signed in blood. Name what you know is there, then sweep up whatever you have not named, and tell them where they are going and that they are not coming back.

One more time, because it is the whole point of the order: if you jump straight to this step without the first five, their legal ground has not been removed, and they will not leave. That is not a failure of authority. It is a failure of sequence.

Pray this out loud. Out loud matters. Fill in every blank with real names and real things, and do not rush any part of it. If you need to stop and weep in the middle of it, stop and weep, then keep going.

blocks.title: Part One · The Full Surrender
blocks.v: Heavenly Father, I come to You in the name of Yahshua. I surrender myself to You completely. My body, my soul, my spirit, my mind, my will, my emotions, my past and my future, I put all of it in Your hands right now. I am not my own anymore. You are my Master, and I submit to You. Take the lead of my life and take it wherever You want it to go. I turn from every sin of my own that I have been holding onto, and I ask You to forgive me and wash me clean in the blood of Yahshua. I submit to You first, Father, so that I can resist the enemy and watch him flee.

blocks.title: Part Two · Confessing The Sins Of The Bloodline
blocks.v: Father, I come before You now and I confess the sins of my bloodline. I confess the sins of my father ____________ and my mother ____________. I specifically confess before You the sin of ____________. I confess the sins of my grandparents ____________, and specifically the sin of ____________. And Father, for every sin in my family line on both sides that I do not know about and cannot name, every oath, every vow, every covenant, every dedication, every act of bloodshed, every dealing with witchcraft, divination, familiar spirits or idolatry, every sexual sin and every act of violence, I confess all of it before You now. I am not defending it, covering it, or excusing it. It was sin, it was against You, and I agree with You about it. I ask You to forgive my bloodline and to blot out its record by the blood of Yahshua.

blocks.title: Part Three · Forgiveness
blocks.v: Father, I choose to forgive. I forgive my father ____________ for ____________. I forgive my mother ____________ for ____________. I forgive them for what they did to me, for what they failed to do for me, and for what it cost me. I am not saying it was small and I am not saying it was right. I am saying I release it into Your hands. Vengeance belongs to You and not to me. Their judgment belongs to You and not to me. I let them go. I lay down every right I have been holding to stay angry, to get even, to hate, and to stay bitter. Father, I repent of the pride in me that wanted to keep holding that debt over them, and I ask You for the humility to keep on forgiving. Where my feelings have not caught up to this yet, I am asking You to heal me. I release these people into Your hands right now.

blocks.title: Part Four · Breaking Ungodly Soul Ties
blocks.v: Father, in the name of Yahshua I break every ungodly soul tie between me and ____________. Every cord, every bond, every tie of the soul formed through abuse, through fear, through control, through manipulation, or through sin, I break it and I sever it now in the name of Yahshua. I take back every piece of myself that was tied up in them, and I give back every piece of them that was tied up in me. I honor them as the one You used to bring me into this world, but I will not stay joined to them in their sin. Cleanse those places in me and join me to You alone.

blocks.title: Part Five · Breaking The Curse Line
blocks.v: Father, I have surrendered to You, I have confessed the sins of my bloodline, I have forgiven, and I have broken every ungodly soul tie. I now ask You to break the generational curse line running into my life. And by the authority You have given me in Yahshua, I speak to it directly. Curse line, I break you. Every strand, every root, every link, every inch of you, from every generation and from both sides of my family, I break you and I cut you off now in the name of Yahshua. You are finished. You have no path into my life, no path into my marriage, no path into my children, and no path into my children's children. Every legal ground, every claim, and every right of access you have ever had is revoked by the blood of Yahshua.

blocks.title: Part Six · Commanding The Spirits To Leave
blocks.v: Now I speak to every demonic spirit that has been working in my life through that curse line. Your ground is gone. Your claim is broken. You have nothing left to hold. In the name of Yahshua I command you to go. Every spirit of fear, every spirit of torment, every spirit of rage, every spirit of lust, every spirit of death, every unclean spirit, every spirit that came down my bloodline, every one I have named and every one I have not, I command you to leave me now. You will not stay. You will not hide. You will not come back. Go where Yahshua sends you and do not return. I belong to YHWH, I am covered by the blood of Yahshua, and this house is His.
Father, fill every place they have left with Your Spirit. Fill me until there is no empty room left for them to come back to. Thank You for my freedom. In the name of Yahshua, amen.

sections.heading: After the prayer: holding the ground

blocks.v: Yahshua warned about a house that gets swept clean and then left empty. The spirit comes back, finds the place swept and in order and unoccupied, and brings seven worse than itself (Matthew 12:43 to 45). Deliverance is the beginning of the work, not the end of it. An empty house is an invitation.

items: Get into the Word every day. Not as a ritual, as food.
Worship. Out loud, in your house, in your car. It changes the atmosphere of a room and of a person.
Keep the Sabbath and keep the rest. Freedom holds better in a life that has rhythm in it. Stay in fellowship. Isolation is where the counterattack does its best work.
Keep short accounts with forgiveness. The moment offense starts to harden again, deal with it that day.
Walk in obedience. Every instruction you obey is one more door you are not leaving unlocked.

blocks.v: Expect a counterattack, and do not panic when it comes. Old thoughts will knock on the door to see if the locks were really changed. A returning thought is not proof that nothing happened. It is a test of whether you will let it back in. You do not have to fight the whole war again. You already broke the ground it was standing on. Refuse it, say so out loud, and keep walking.
And be patient with the healing. Cutting a cord takes a moment. Growing up healthy underneath where that cord used to be takes time, and YHWH is not in a hurry with people He loves.
James 4:7 Submission comes before resistance Leviticus 26:40, 42 Confessing the iniquity of the fathers
Exodus 20:5, Exodus 34:7, Numbers 14:18 Iniquity visiting the generations Ezekiel 18:20, Deuteronomy 24:16 Guilt is not inherited
Matthew 6:14 and 15 Forgiveness given and forgiveness received
Deuteronomy 32:35, Romans 12:19 Vengeance belongs to YHWH

1 Corinthians 6:16 and 17 The principle of the soul tie Matthew 16:19 Binding and loosing Luke 10:19 Authority over all the power of the enemy Mark 16:17 Casting out spirits in His name Ephesians 6:10 to 18 The armor and the sword Colossians 2:14 and 15 The record nailed to the tree Matthew 12:43 to 45 Do not leave the house empty
